evidence.reason: AE-08 phase 8 steps 3+4 (M3, E5) added the seam-adoptable snapshot to compileSnapshot of the portable controller, so the live-content gate now reads withLiveContentOf(adoptable, activeSnapshot). The anchors of the gate arms 489, 490 and 491 are re-pointed to the same gate lines (the 490 and 491 mutants keep their meaning: drop the live-content normalisation, drop the fingerprint guard). Each is run alone with --only (see PHASE8-STEP3-4-E5.md). The watched hashes of the controller and the three witness files are not recorded: they move only on --full. The recorded failing sets of the arms 469, 471, 472, 476, 482, 486, 489, 490 and 494 name tests that phase 8 renamed or whose expectation it changed on purpose (a structural MIDI clip edit and a MIDI clip move are now adopted, so the test that expected a rebuild is renamed; a resume after an adoption re-prepares, because the adopted schedule starts at its seam and ends where the old one ended, so no resume in place is left to compile nothing). Each renamed witness is recorded under its new name where the mutant still fails it; a witness that no longer fails under its mutant is dropped from that arm, whose remaining recorded witnesses still kill it.
